description: Unknown VoIP caller on a bad line asks 'send me 5000 rupees' with urgency; no payment app yet. C stays low (VoIP + unknown = 35) and L stays low (one money ask), so R used to read Safe while the transcript highlighted the ask. The evidence floor must show a nudge, and nothing above it without a payment.
